description: This file contains the implementation of the AWCContainer class within the Thunder::ProcessContainers namespace. It manages container lifecycle operations such as start, stop, and state change notifications, and interacts with an AWCClient for container control.

classes.name: AWCContainer
classes.description: Class responsible for managing container lifecycle, including starting, stopping, and monitoring container state, using an AWCClient and notifier.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID if the container is in the started state, otherwise 0.

methods.name: AWCContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running based on internal state variables.

methods.name: AWCContainer::WaitUntilAWCReady
methods.description: Polls the AWC service until it reports readiness or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters, waiting for confirmation.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, waiting for confirmation or timeout.

methods.name: AWCContainer::notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from the AWCClient, updating internal state accordingly.
